_default.note: Main page is the layout's own scene; Details / Achievements / Options open the shared readable page (sharedPageFor). No native pages yet; motion rules in UI_POLISH_COMPLETION.md. Owner approval needed before redesign.

STORAGE.note: Record sheets file in from the D-pad side, tab paper slides. WinFocusRoboTest (real window, JVM).

NIGHT.note: Slanted panels sweep along the slant; banner wipe with a dark band. WinFocusRoboTest.

TILES.note: Card writing turns over like tiles per page. WinFocusRoboTest.

BLADES.note: Page blades slide in over / away; game blade keeps its full name on its edge. WinFocusRoboTest.

GRID.note: Shares Tiles' window scene (TILE_CARD), so it gets the Tiles native pages too. Not separately reviewed or JVM-tested.

SHELF.note: Pages: shared page. Case flight hand-over (CaseFlightGate, ShownScans) - no picture flash; owner's spine flicker NOT confirmed fixed.

CARDS.note: Popup-first: A opens the window by default (cards_a_plays default off, same key).

POCKET.note: Popup-first: A opens the window by default (pq_a_plays default off, same key).

CROSS.note: Keeps its own options list for Options; other pages shared.

TV.note: No scene: the TV room's own window on the TV's screen (TvWindowBody).
